title: Integration map: consume other authorities, do not absorb them
summary: Deployment integrates with Semantic Source Control, Foreign Runtime, HTTPS Server, Wire UI, MCP Project Service, Storage/transfer providers, Job-to-Node allocation and Queue/process execution while preserving their authority boundaries. It prepares/verifies execution state; it does not become those components.
invariants: Semantic Source Control owns ooRexx semantic component/source dependency identity; Deployment consumes that graph and materialises the selected closure.
Foreign Runtime owns its runtime/native API semantics; Deployment decides whether the declared artifact is loadable and how permitted repair occurs.
HTTPS Server owns route/listener behavior; Deployment respects its composition lifecycle.
MCP and Wire own protocol/UI semantics; Deployment consumes adapter declarations and probes.
Storage/transport providers move bytes; Deployment owns desired placement and verification.
Job-to-Node determines placement eligibility/ranking; Deployment reconciles a selected target.
Queue/application code decides work semantics; Deployment only launches when requested.

provenance.claim: Defines SSC versus Deployment authority split.
Defines dependency integration flow and split authority.
